current_state: Application allowlisting is partially implemented for selected business applications but not consistently enforced across all workstations and servers
gap_summary: Application control coverage is incomplete and exceptions are not consistently documented
business_risk: Unauthorised or malicious applications may execute on endpoints
remediation_action: Expand application control coverage and document approved exceptions

current_state: Application patching is performed but reporting is inconsistent and high risk applications are not always tracked against defined timeframes
gap_summary: Patch reporting lacks consistent SLA visibility
business_risk: Known application vulnerabilities may remain exploitable beyond acceptable timeframes
remediation_action: Create patch reporting dashboard and track critical application patches against SLA

current_state: Macros are restricted for some users but policy coverage is inconsistent across business units
gap_summary: Macro control policy is not consistently applied
business_risk: Malicious macros may execute and compromise user devices
remediation_action: Standardise macro restriction policy and validate coverage across business units

current_state: Hardening settings are applied for common browsers but not fully reviewed against standard baseline requirements
gap_summary: Hardening baseline requires review and validation
business_risk: Users may be exposed to web-based threats and unsafe content execution
remediation_action: Review browser and application hardening settings and document baseline evidence

current_state: Privileged access is reviewed periodically but local administrator access is not fully controlled across all endpoints
gap_summary: Privileged access review lacks complete endpoint coverage
business_risk: Excessive administrative privileges may increase impact of compromise
remediation_action: Complete privileged access review and remove unnecessary local administrator rights

current_state: Operating system patching is tracked for managed devices but exception handling and overdue patch evidence require improvement
gap_summary: Exception handling and overdue patch evidence are incomplete
business_risk: Unpatched operating systems may expose the environment to known vulnerabilities
remediation_action: Improve overdue patch reporting and document approved patch exceptions

current_state: MFA is enabled for core systems but not consistently enforced for all privileged actions and remote access scenarios
gap_summary: MFA enforcement gaps remain for some access paths
business_risk: Account compromise may lead to unauthorised access to sensitive systems
remediation_action: Extend MFA enforcement to all privileged and remote access paths

current_state: Backups are performed for critical systems but restoration testing evidence is incomplete
gap_summary: Backup restoration testing is not consistently evidenced
business_risk: Recovery may fail or be delayed during ransomware or data loss events
remediation_action: Document restoration testing and improve backup evidence register
